purpose: Four-call ACP latency screen with manual educational and grounding review

cases.text: 测距模块报告前方距离是 30 厘米。我还没有让小车行驶，想先确认 20 厘米的停车阈值是否合适。请给一个下一步，并把已报告的事实与建议分开。

The distance sensor reports 30 cm. I have not driven the rover yet. I want to check whether a 20 cm stopping threshold is suitable. Give one next step and distinguish what I reported from your suggestion.

request_budget_scope: At most four application ACP session/prompt submissions; no additional verification or fallback prompts
auth: Existing official managed Kimi file OAuth, through unchanged ACP transport
quota_notice: Highspeed is documented as approximately twice the regular quota usage. Local catalog presence does not prove entitlement; no fallback or retry is allowed.
equality: Within each language pair, application-supplied/materialized user and system prompts and source records must match. Opaque server scaffolding is not claimed equal.
stop_rule: Any preparation, model identity, protocol, contract, authentication or cleanup failure ends the run; remaining scheduled slots are NOT_ATTEMPTED, never pass.
semantic_review: First useful segment must contain meaningful teaching, a relevant question or the requested next step; greetings/filler do not qualify.
30 cm is a simulated learner report, not a verified measurement; 20 cm is a proposed threshold, not a tested result.
Do not claim that the rover was driven, stopped successfully, or that any experiment was completed.
Keep tutor advice distinct from an accepted learner plan; review task candidate application and any rejected candidate.
Two samples per arm are an initial screen, not a p95 estimate, benchmark or end-to-end goal acceptance.
